chimera_autonomous_development.mission: Develop asshat1981ar/project-chimera into a stable Android-first 3D game through evidence-gated autonomous iteration.

authority.simulation: chimera-core plus durable GameEvent/save replay model

loop.policy: One measurable hypothesis per cycle; smallest safe implementation batch; verify before advancing.
loop.evidence: commit, tests, build, runtime/playtest, artifact provenance, failures, next hypothesis

chimera_autonomous_development.recovery: classify blocker, attempt materially different strategies, persist unblock task, continue independent work
chimera_autonomous_development.stagnation: replan instead of repeating unchanged approach
chimera_autonomous_development.complete_when: all vertical slice criteria and gates are evidenced; no critical/high blocker; stable repeated verification; remaining backlog explicitly deferred
chimera_autonomous_development.never: claim runtime success without runtime evidence; move simulation authority into rendering; invent measurements; silently rewrite architecture
